Open Roads & Mountain Horizons: SAACURC 2016, Ferrell Parkway & The Horizon Avalon

2016–2020 • Blacksburg, 55 MPH Behind the Wheel, Luray & Buying a Car on Our Own Terms

Ride along on Michael and Rachel's adult milestones across Virginia—representing VDU at the SAACURC conference in Blacksburg, earning independence behind the wheel, Thanksgiving in Luray, and bringing home the 2020 Horizon Avalon.
